title: Closing apps
drDigitalIntro:
To close an app window, click the red X button in the corner of the window.
• This removes the window from your screen.
• Warning: on a real computer, Ctrl+Q or Cmd+Q quits the app immediately. Do not press those keys right now.
• The yellow minus button is different — it minimizes the window (hides it without closing it).
• Let's practice: close the window below using the red X.

steps.say: Click the red X button to close this window.

drDigitalSuccess: Perfect — red X to close the window. You've got it!
drDigitalHint: Look for the red X button in the top corner of the window and click it.
